name: EVC Scheduling Stall Escalation
description: Escalates cases queued in EVC_PENDING where an inspection date or 3-member committee roster has not been confirmed within SLA.

tiers.description: Level 1: 3 days overdue past 7-day scheduling window. Alert to Regional Director to expedite panel empanelment.
tiers.actionRequired: Expedite committee assignment or appoint alternate experts.

tiers.description: Level 2: 7 days overdue. Escalated to Central Approval Bureau Head for national expert pool allocation.

autoResolutionCondition: EVC inspection confirmed and case moved to EVC_SCHEDULED.
